rules.accepted_credit_types: Programs accepted by another state veterinary board, a governmental entity and/or AAVSB (RACE); programs of AVMA-accredited veterinary schools and Board-recognized professional associations; others need Board pre-approval at least 14 days before
rules.carryover: Not allowed; only hours from the 12-month CE period count.
rules.alternatives: Extension of up to 90 days after September 30 by petition for extenuating circumstances.
rules.notes: Hours earned July 1 - June 30; proof uploaded in the LBVM License Portal by September 30 (license expiration). Max 10 h online (incl. live Zoom). Certificates must state the delivery method. Presenters get no credit for presenting.
